profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, trading under the ticker SOUN. According to its website, its OASYS platform powers voice-native AI agents that handle service, operations, and commerce conversations for enterprise brands. The site describes the company as offering conversational AI agents for the real world, with quoted customers saying the agentic AI resolves more requests faster and improves interaction quality, that voice AI lets franchisees process orders more efficiently during peak hours, and that hybrid cloud and embedded connectivity support always-on voice experiences.

The company's own materials frame its position around agentic and voice AI for enterprise customer service, operations, and ordering. No products are separately tracked in the record, and no MCP servers are listed.

The record shows no lawsuits. It notes law exposure in Delaware, with a count of 33.
